pages.text: The $(d)Slimy Death$() Gene makes it so, $(9)upon the player dying, they are instantly revived and several friendly Support Slimes spawn$().$(br2)This has a configurable cooldown, with the default being 5 minutes.$(br2)This Gene $(c)cannot be given to mobs$()
These are the default chances. Modpacks may change them.$(br2)2/16 - Slime$(br)1/1 - Support Slime
